name: m4-pr212-incompletion-typer
description: Does [retronym/scala#212](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/212)'s last commit cost the batch typer anything? It replaces `lockedCount`, a field the namer's completers incremented, with `inCompletion`, the depth of the thread's completion frame. `typeAsMemberOf` reads it on every call during the typer, and it now goes through `scratch` (a lazy val and two field loads) where it read one field.

`pre` vs `tip` isolates that commit. `base` vs `tip` measures the whole PR again after the review's changes (guard exception safety and encapsulation, the shared-state scan, deprecations, frames that record their symbol). `aa` is a second build of `base`, the noise floor. re2s and scalap stopped after the typer. Release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap. Builds alternate fork by fork over 5 rounds. Compare within this campaign only.

variantDescriptions.aa: the same commit as `base`, for the noise floor
variantDescriptions.pre: the PR at `817d458847`, before the `lockedCount` change
